correctness.rationale: A fresh independent integer-arithmetic reconstruction (not the saved verification log) enumerated all 71,608 positive even practical numbers at most 716683 using factorization, and exactly 208 odd Zumkeller numbers through 100000 using proper-divisor bitset subset sums. It verified all 99225 odd congruence classes modulo 198450 are covered by p+945u with 48 allowed u, last practical p=539968 and maximal base 716683. It checked that the finite odd bridge from 19069 to 716683 misses only 20177, which is 20176+1 with 20176 Zumkeller, and that 19067 cannot split because p=1 leaves nonabundant 19066 while every even practical p<19067 leaves z failing a necessary Zumkeller sigma condition. For n beyond 716683, modular lifting with u+210t coprime to 945 provides the infinite proof, and even n>=8 have direct finite-class representations. This validates C while recognizing the theorem is already known.
